record.question: Which one of the following statements is inaccurate about demand for scheme works?
options: The demand should be confined to those works only which have received administrative approval in cases where such approval is required.
For "Minor Works" and "Maintenance & Repairs", demands should be provided justifying the total demand for each work/sub-head.
In cases where such lump sum provisions are made for Schemes or Non-Schemes, detailed justification should be given in support of the demands made.
A separate statement for schemes for which administrative approval has not yet been obtained shall be included in the proposal for seeking approval of government.
